test_equals_period_index: test the EqualsTests class for PeriodIndex equality comparisons with different frequencies
test_equals_datetime_index: test the EqualsTests class for DatetimeIndex equality comparisons including timezone-aware indexes
test_equals_timedelta_index: test the EqualsTests class for TimedeltaIndex equality comparisons including out-of-range values
test_index_not_equals_numeric: test that DatetimeIndex, TimedeltaIndex, and PeriodIndex are not equal to their numeric representations
test_index_not_equals_strings: test that DatetimeIndex, TimedeltaIndex, and PeriodIndex are not equal to string indexes
test_index_not_equals_list: test that DatetimeIndex, TimedeltaIndex, and PeriodIndex are not equal to plain Python lists
test_index_equals_self_and_copy: test that DatetimeIndex, TimedeltaIndex, and PeriodIndex equal themselves and their copies
test_equals_out_of_bounds: test that DatetimeIndex and TimedeltaIndex do not raise on out-of-bounds datetime or timedelta comparisons
